description: Firebase Security Rules Audit — Offline audit of Firebase security rules: Cloud Firestore and Cloud Storage rules (rules_version/service/match/allow) or Realtime Database rules JSON. Flags public read/write (allow ... if true or no condition), test-mode expiry rules (request.time < timestamp.date), any-signed-in-user writes (request.auth != null only), recursive {document=**} grants, missing data validation, Storage uploads without size/content-type limits, unverified email trust, RTDB .read/.write true and auth != null. Returns per-statement paths, findings with fixes, score, grade and verdict OK/REVIEW/INSECURE. Param rules= (aliases text=, config=). Price: $0.005 USDC (Base, via x402).

rules.description: e.g. rules_version = '2'; service cloud.firestore { match /databases/{database}/documents { match /{document=**} { allow read, write: if true; } } }

name: security_firebase_rules_check
